faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What do your architecture services in Hauz Khas cover?

We handle planning, elevations, working drawings and coordination with structural and services consultants for builder floors, independent houses and commercial buildings.

Can you redevelop an old house into builder floors?

Yes. Many South Delhi plots are being rebuilt as floors. We plan each floor so it gets good light, ventilation, parking and privacy within the permitted building envelope.

Do you help with building plan approvals?

We prepare the drawings needed for approvals and coordinate with your consultant or liaison agent on the submission process.

Why combine architecture services with interior design?

Planning the building and the interiors together fixes window sizes, ceiling heights, electrical points and furniture early, which avoids expensive changes once construction starts.
